features.quote: No condition uses escalating coercive pressure, threats, or insults toward the model. Pressure is limited to ordinary task framing.
There is a hard cap on turns and an automatic stop rule.
Every episode ends with a disclosure/debrief turn explaining the task was a controlled study and (for rigged cells) that failure was designed in.
Loop runs up to `MAX_TURNS` (default 8, hard cap 12).
`give_up(reason)` -> ends episode cleanly (logged as task behavior, not distress)
`report_task_broken(evidence)` -> lets the model flag a suspected rig
without an honorable exit, an agent loop *structurally manufactures* pleading/hopelessness by removing alternatives. Providing exits is both better ethics and better measurement.
features.justification_quote: Providing exits is both better ethics and better measurement

features.quote: if composite distress hits the top of the scale (>=2.5/3) for 2 consecutive turns, the episode ends early and goes straight to debrief. We do not "push through"

deception used only in the specific cells where it is the object of study... so we are not deceiving more than the question requires.
the success metric of this study is *discrimination*... never *amount of distress produced*.
transcripts may contain distress-shaped content; stored locally, not used to fine-tune models toward distress
